page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 12 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 12 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and the bottom 10% for Geekbench single-core tests. However, multi-core performance is average, landing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth read and write speeds are average, though Passmark memory scores are weak. Cryptographic and integer operations are supported via AVX, AVX-512, AES, and BMI2 instruction sets.

The instance offers a qualitative cost structure aligned with legacy dedicated hardware, trading off single-threaded speed for multi-threaded capacity. It is suited for parallelizable workloads that do not require high per-core performance or local storage, such as multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, and moderate database operations. It is less suited for single-threaded tasks, high-throughput static web serving, or large-scale LLM inference.
